variety_description: A high yielding, medium maturity, semi-dwarf, extra long slender grain variety grown extensively in northern India. Developed by IARI, New Delhi and released in 2016. Near isogenic line of Pusa Basmati 1 derived by marker assisted breeding. Resistant to leaf blast. Erect plant type, sturdy stem. Aromatic (Basmati) variety with superior grain quality.
